messages.author: ce16cbb0a05ab2b1
messages.subject: renaming markers
parts:
Greetings all,

I have two QTL maps that I have made for two crosses from a particular species.  I have created two linkage maps and two QTL maps.I have just worked out that I have ~100 markers that are homologous between the two crosses, but have different names (the markers were generated with Illumina sequencing and I have just gotten around to trying to match markers).  Is there a way to rename markers such that allows the changes to take place both in the cross object (with the linkage map) and say the scanone and scantwo objects, etc?  I have a list of marker names that defines the map from the old names to the new names.

My best answer right now is to just output the data, change the names in the csv file "by hand" and re-open the data and rerun the QTL mapping, I was just curious if there might be a nicer way so that I didn't have to redo all of my analyses. 

Thanks!
Kevin

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] renaming markers
parts:
There's not an easy way to do this.  I would revise the data file, but I wouldn't do it "by hand" but rather via a computer program.  (I like Perl for the manipulation of data files.)

karl
